articles.summary: Planned acquisition establishes the foundation for York Terrestrial Systems, uniting unmanned platforms with York’s proven space, ground, and communications infrastructure York Space Systems (York) (NYSE: YSS), a leading, US-based national defense and commercial prime providing a comprehensive suite of mission-enabling solutions, today announced its intent to acquire Outlook Industries, a developer of unmanned systems for defense applications. Upon closing, Outlook will form the foundation of York Terrestrial Systems , marking York’s entry into terrestrial systems and extending its capabilities to include unmanned platforms connected by its proven space, ground, and communications infrastructure. The acquisition represents the next step in completing York’s integrated ecosystem for unmanned operations, from flight-proven spacecraft and global ground infrastructure to mobile communications terminals and systems operating in the field.
